calculation_handling.description: Despite 5.10.40.70(2), required minimum ancillary building setbacks apply to all parts of an ancillary building containing a garden suite above and below ground, excluding footings.
calculation_handling.gaps: Measurement inclusion rule; no DSL variable. No zone named.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(2) and (5) and 10.10.60.20(1), on a lot deeper than 45.0 m the minimum rear yard setback of a garden suite building is the greater of 1.5 m or half its height.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'half' written as 0.5 ratio; proposed_height_m is the garden suite building's height (a scenario value).

calculation_handling.description: In all other cases (lot depth 45.0 m or less) the minimum rear yard setback of a garden suite building is 1.5 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'In all other cases' is the residual of (A); its threshold literal is not in this clause, so condition is none (on deep lots (A) is never less than 1.5 m, so no conflict).

calculation_handling.description: If the rear lot line abuts a lot in the Residential Zone category and the garden suite building has openings such as windows in its rear main wall above 4.0 m above average grade, the (B) rear yard setback of 1.5 m is increased by 1.5 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: The first 1.5 m is the (B) value being increased. The conditions (rear abutting lot is in a Residential zone; rear-wall openings above 4.0 m) have no condition tokens; the zone list records the abutting lot's zone category, not the subject lot's.

units.disclosure: If your garden suite has rear windows higher than 4.0 m and backs onto a residential lot, the rear setback rises to 3.0 m; tell us your window plan.

calculation_handling.description: On a through lot where a residential building on an adjacent lot fronts on the street abutting the rear lot line, the garden suite building's minimum rear yard setback equals the required minimum front yard setback for the residential building on the adjacent lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: The adjacent lot's REQUIRED front setback has no DSL variable, so no expression; the adjacent-lot-fronts-rear-street test has no token.

units.disclosure: On a through lot, a garden suite must be set back from the rear street as far as the neighbour's required front setback; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: In all other cases of the through-lot rule, the garden suite building's minimum rear yard setback is 1.5 metres.
For a garden suite building with a parking space on a through lot with vehicle access from the rear street, one argument of the greater-of is the rear yard setback required by 150.7.60.20(3)(A).
calculation_handling.gaps: Cross-reference arm to (3)(A) (the adjacent lot's required front setback), which has no DSL variable. Vehicle access from the rear street is a design input.

units.disclosure: A garden suite with parking on a through lot, entered from the rear street, needs at least the neighbour's required front setback or 6.0 m; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: For a garden suite building with a parking space on a through lot with vehicle access from the rear street, the minimum rear yard setback is the greater of the (3)(A) setback or 6.0 metres; this unit carries the 6.0 m argument.
calculation_handling.gaps: Vehicle access from the rear street and the parking space are design inputs; the other max() argument is unit (4)(A).

numeric_expression: side_setback_m = max(1.5 m; min(10 pct × lot_frontage_m; 3.0 m)) @(5)(A)

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3) and (6) and 10.10.60.20(1), where the side lot line does not abut a street and the side main wall has openings such as doors or windows, the garden suite's minimum side yard setback is the greater of 1.5 m or 10 percent of the lot frontage, to a maximum of 3.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only to a side not abutting a street with wall openings (suite_wall_openings); no condition token for either. 'To a maximum of 3.0 metres' read as capping the 10 percent amount.

numeric_expression: side_setback_m = max(0.6 m; min(10 pct × lot_frontage_m; 3.0 m)) @(5)(B)

calculation_handling.description: In all other cases, the garden suite's minimum side yard setback is the greater of 0.6 m or 10 percent of the lot frontage, to a maximum of 3.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: Residual of (A) (no openings, or the side abuts a street); selection between (A) and (B) needs the wall-openings input.

evidence.adjacent_lot_fronts_flanking_street: adjacent lot fronts on the street

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.60.20(3)(C)(i), on a corner lot where a residential building on an adjacent lot fronts the flanking street, the garden suite's minimum side yard setback is the average of the adjacent building's front yard setback and the principal building's minimum required side yard setback, but never less than 1.5 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: The averaging arm ((abutting_front_setback_m + side_setback_m) / 2) needs a divisor literal that is not in the text, so only the 1.5 m floor is expressed; the true value may be higher. Keyed to side_setback_street_m because the side lot line abuts a street.

units.disclosure: On a corner lot next to a house facing your side street, a garden suite's street-side setback is an average of the neighbour's front setback and your house's side setback (at least 1.5 m); we only check the 1.5 m floor.

calculation_handling.description: On a corner lot, a garden suite building containing a parking space with vehicle access from the flanking street has a minimum side yard setback of the greater of 6.0 m or the (A) setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: Only the 6.0 m argument is expressed; the (A) argument is carried by unit (6)(A). Parking space and flanking-street access are design inputs.

calculation_handling.description: In all other corner-lot cases, the garden suite's minimum side yard setback is the greater of the required minimum side yard setback for the residential building on the lot or 1.5 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: The other max() argument is the residential building's side_setback_m, the same target name as this unit's, so it cannot be written without circularity; only 1.5 m is expressed. Condition corner_lot read from the stem heading 'Garden Suite on Corner Lot' and the (A)/(B) context.

150.7.60.20(1).explanation: Garden suite setbacks are measured to every part of the building above and below ground, except footings.

150.7.60.20(2).explanation: A garden suite must be at least 1.5 m from the rear lot line; on lots deeper than 45 m, at least half its height if that is more. If it has rear windows higher than 4.0 m facing a residential lot, add 1.5 m.

150.7.60.20(3).explanation: On a through lot where the neighbour faces the rear street, a garden suite must be set back from that street as far as the neighbour's required front setback; otherwise 1.5 m.

150.7.60.20(4).explanation: A garden suite with a parking space on a through lot, entered from the rear street, needs at least 6.0 m rear setback, or the neighbour's front setback if larger.

150.7.60.20(5).explanation: A garden suite's side setback is 10% of the lot frontage (up to 3.0 m), but at least 1.5 m if the side wall has doors or windows facing a neighbour, or at least 0.6 m otherwise.

150.7.60.20(6).explanation: On a corner lot, a garden suite's side setback depends on the neighbour's front setback and your house's side setback (never under 1.5 m), and is at least 6.0 m if it has parking entered from the side street.
